## Scope and owner

Task IDs, owned paths, and receiving owners:

## Verification

Exact commands, actual outcomes, test counts and artifact references. Separate local, physical-device, public-testnet and incomplete cases. Foundation CI is not wallet/MPC acceptance.

## Interfaces and migrations

Schema/ABI/domain version; migration classification/checksums; old/new compatibility; backfill or manual steps. State explicitly when none.

## Deployment and rollback

Image/source identity, environment/config changes, restart/journal implications and compatible rollback. Ordinary changes must not deploy signer software, keys or contracts.

## Secrets and remaining work

Secret names/versions only, never values. Known risks, blocked cases and next owner/action.
